slice: tenant-scoped nutrient input and harvest-removal event reads

tests.command: python3 -m pytest tests/test_gateway_nutrient_events.py tests/test_gateway_nutrient_soil_tests.py tests/test_gateway_nutrient_balances.py tests/test_nutrient_budget.py tests/test_operator_auth.py -q

verified_contract: Exact private nutrient_budget:read location policies for inputs and removals; other methods, event types, and suffixes do not match
Invalid event type, location UUID, and page values fail before opening PostgreSQL
One repeatable-read, read-only transaction installs signed tenant context before count and page reads
Both event types join through nutrient_budget and filter the requested parent location and recorded/verified event statuses
Event and parent budget lifecycle statuses remain separate in output
Inputs return product/type, application rate, and N/P/K; removals return harvest/crop/yield and N/P/K
Plot IDs are returned only when the related plot's farm belongs to the requested location
Budget IDs, costs, notes, arbitrary metadata, and removal-factor source text are omitted
Responses are bounded, no-store, and missing tenant grants deny before service access
known_gap: nutrient_input.cost has no documented currency, so cost output and legacy cost-summary parity remain open.
rollback: Remove the additive event route, exact authorization policy, service module, focused tests, and documentation; no schema or data rollback is needed.
